# GuideLink v0.1.8

GuideLink now sets up m3u-editor's native recurring EPG map after a successful
playlist sync. GuideLink still matches provider channels to the lineup and saves
their channel numbers and XMLTV IDs; m3u-editor owns EPG associations and refreshes.

## Changes

- Create or update one GuideLink-managed EPG map for the selected playlist and
  guide. The map covers the whole playlist, overwrites existing associations,
  prefers XMLTV IDs over names, and repeats after EPG refresh. Existing
  user-managed maps are preserved. Native EPG opt-outs and VOD exclusions apply.
- Queue native mapping after each successful applying sync, including when
  channel metadata is already current. GuideLink reports queued or processing;
  mapping completion and errors appear in **EPG Maps**.
- Make **Programme guide logos** configure the map's **Set preferred icon to
  EPG** option. Custom logo overrides remain intact, and missing EPG icons fall
  back to provider logos. Choosing provider logos still resets matched channels.
- Add Sky Cinema Spider-Man and Spider-Man HD to the bundled Sky UK aliases,
  retaining previous seasonal names.
- Withhold a stale bundled alias and warn instead of blocking the whole sync.
  Affected unresolved channels retain their metadata and enabled state for
  review. Conflicting custom aliases still fail validation.
- Remove direct EPG association writes and redundant metadata, unify source
  preparation, and clarify the handoff to the host mapper. EPG setup does not
  inspect or repair individual channel associations.

## Upgrade

Install `guidelink.zip` using the
[reviewed update flow](https://github.com/djrarky/GuideLink/blob/v0.1.8/docs/INSTALL.md#update-an-existing-install),
then reload queue and web workers as described there. Profiles, assignments,
custom aliases and source caches are preserved; no plugin schema change is needed.

The host must support native recurring EPG Maps, ID-first matching,
`set_epg_icon`, and the `SkipIfSyncReset` guard. Numeric channel numbers are used
by GuideLink to obtain XMLTV IDs; the native mapper matches those IDs, not the
numeric channel field itself.

Run **Preview Sync**, then **Run Sync** to create the native map. Check **EPG
Maps** for completion. Installation alone does not create or run a map. The map
includes later imports without requiring GuideLink to rebuild a channel list.

Download `guidelink.zip` for installation. `SHA256SUMS` verifies the assets and
`release.json` records every packaged file hash.

## Validation

- All **277 plugin tests (2,003 assertions)** passed locally on PHP 8.4.16 with
  SQLite against the m3u-editor integration harness.
- Native-job tests cover ID priority, changed guide names and replacement rows,
  incorrect or missing associations, later imports, EPG logo preference,
  native exclusions, preview, and in-progress mapping settings.
- Standalone validation and PHP formatting passed. Packaging and release-tool
  checks, plus the full PostgreSQL host suite, run in the release workflow.

Local verification covers existing-installation behaviour and synthetic source
fixtures. First-run browser setup and every upstream source were not rechecked
for this release.
